create_graph: create a gtn Graph object to represent a finite state transducer with start and final nodes
add_node: add a node to the graph with optional initial and final state flags
add_arc: add an arc between two nodes in the graph labeled with a symbol index
draw_graph: draw and export a gtn graph to a PDF file with symbol labels for nodes and arcs
union_graphs: compute the union of multiple gtn graphs into a single combined graph
